description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Cost 4 Vitae

Whatever gets up is the same weight, roughly, and has most of the same parts.

You are instead reduced to 1 Hit Point and immediately enter a monstrous form you can produce, at no cost, for 1 minute. When it ends you are drained 2, and the GM chooses one cosmetic feature that does not go back.

cinderfall.incomplete: The 0-to-1-HP floor is self-targeting and matches real precedent (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/orc/level-1/orc-ferocity.json, rules: []) -- no action needed on that half. The "immediately enter a monstrous form you can produce, at no cost" clause depends on an unnamed other card and is itself activation+duration-buff-shaped with no companion effect: This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation.
